name: FormDeck: Simple Form Builder with WhatsApp Floating Forms

You will then automatically be redirected to the “Data” page, from there you can edit your form or create a form on any of your pages or posts using the shortcode.

sections.faq:
How to Create a WhatsApp Form in WordPress?

It’s quite easy to get started with the FormDeck plugin. To get started, activate the FormDeck(simple form), create a form using drag and drop builder, then visit WhatsApp Tabs- FormDeck whatsApp Settings, configure WhatsApp redirection, and enter your WhatsApp number. Once form submit it will redirected user to the whatsApp chat mobile app or whatsApp web.

How to active Connect Contact Form 7 as a floating widgets?

Configure Contact Form 7 from CF7 Tabs of FormDeck and Enable Contact Forms 7 as floating widgets from General tabs.

How to active Connect Contact Form 7 as WhatsApp Form with WordPress?

First configure Contact Form 7 from CF7 Tabs of FormDeck and Enable Contact Forms 7 as floating widgets from General tabs. Then Enable Contact Forms 7 as floating widgets and Select Contact Forms 7 forms for WhatsApp redirection from WhatsApp Tabs.

Is there any action hook that can be used after the form submission event?

Yes, ‘FormDeck_form_submit’ action hook added to use. It takes a parameter in which you can collect the form submission data by passing the following keys. E.g. $form[‘form_id’]; $form[‘fields’]; $form[‘time’] here ‘fields’ used to collect the form submission data.
